[{"sha":"0145fb17493f73b128156f1e0d4a279ca9ca7e3a","node_id":"C_kwDOAmegOtoAKDAxNDVmYjE3NDkzZjczYjEyODE1NmYxZTBkNGEyNzljYTljYTdlM2E","commit":{"author":{"name":"Maksym Lyskov","email":"84620852+maxymlyskov@users.noreply.github.com","date":"2026-10-31T15:28:55Z"},"committer":{"name":"GitHub","email":"noreply@github.com","date":"2026-10-31T15:28:55Z"},"message":"fix(Scatter): keep a z value of 0 for bubble size and tooltip (#8026)

## Description

`computeScatterPoints` in `src/cartesian/Scatter.tsx` read z like this:

```ts
const z: unknown = (!isNullish(zAxisDataKey) && getValueByDataKey(entry, zAxisDataKey)) || '-';
```

The `|| '-'` turns a z of 0 into the `'-'` marker. The tooltip z row is
pushed only when `z !== '-'`, and the size is `zAxis.scale.map(z)` only
when `z !== '-'`, else `defaultZ` (the first value of the ZAxis range).
So a z=0 point gets the smallest bubble whatever 0 maps to, and its
tooltip has no z row. The size part shows when 0 isn't the bottom of the
z domain, e.g. a domain with negative and positive values. The missing
tooltip row happens every time.

Now it's:

```ts
const rawZ: unknown = getValueByDataKey(entry, zAxisDataKey);
const z: unknown = isNullish(rawZ) || isNan(rawZ) ? '-' : rawZ;
```

I dropped the `!isNullish(zAxisDataKey)` guard because
`getValueByDataKey` already returns `undefined` for a nullish dataKey
(its first `if`), so no ZAxis, or a ZAxis without `dataKey`, still gives
`'-'`. That's the only src change. x and y in the same function already
keep 0 with plain `getValueByDataKey`.

Unchanged: non-zero z, z `undefined`, `null` or `NaN` (smallest size, no
z row), charts without a ZAxis `dataKey`.

One side effect: an empty-string z now gets a z row and whatever the
scale returns (550 in the test chart). Nothing throws and no NaN reaches
the DOM.

The same line is in v2.15.4 and 3.10.1, so it's been there since 2.x.

## Related Issue

Fixes #8025.

## Motivation and Context

0 is a real z value. The issue's chart (ZAxis range [100, 1000], z =
-10, 0, 10) in Chromium, axes domain [0, 4] so the z=10 bubble isn't
clipped, hovering the middle point:

```text
== base: published recharts 3.10.1 (npm, tarball sha256 c67f9683487503743c769b188e7bc89cfbe438fb963f01c3e67df6365eb045b1)
bubble widths: 11.3, 11.3, 35.7 · tooltip: x : 2 | y : 2 · console errors: 0
== fix: this branch (src b81ad8e67ad + the fix), npm run build es6/
bubble widths: 11.3, 26.5, 35.7 · tooltip: x : 2 | y : 2 | z : 0 · console errors: 0
```

## How Has This Been Tested?

- New `with a z value of 0` describe at the end of `<Scatter />` in
`test/cartesian/Scatter.spec.tsx`: size from the z scale (sizes [100,
550, 1000] for z -10, 0, 10), z in the tooltip payload, and `z : 0` in
the DOM tooltip on hover.
- Controls via `it.each` over `undefined`, `null` and `NaN`: smallest
size and no z in the tooltip.
- The 3 new tests fail on main b81ad8e, the 3 controls pass on both:

```text
 FAIL  |unit:lib| test/cartesian/Scatter.spec.tsx > <Scatter /> > with a z value of 0 > should size the bubble by the z scale
AssertionError: expected [ 100, 100, 1000 ] to deeply equal [ 100, 550, 1000 ]
 FAIL  |unit:lib| test/cartesian/Scatter.spec.tsx > <Scatter /> > with a z value of 0 > should put z in the tooltip payload
AssertionError: expected [ [ -10 ], [], [ 10 ] ] to deeply equal [ [ -10 ], [ +0 ], [ 10 ] ]
 FAIL  |unit:lib| test/cartesian/Scatter.spec.tsx > <Scatter /> > with a z value of 0 > should show z in the tooltip on hover
AssertionError: expected [ 'x : 2', 'y : 2' ] to deeply equal [ 'x : 2', 'y : 2', 'z : 0' ]
      Tests  3 failed | 3 passed | 18 skipped (24)
```

- Whole spec with the fix: 24 passed.
- `npm run build`, then `npm test`: 377 files, 17485 passed, 0 failed (6
expected fail, 16 skipped, 1 todo).
- `check-types-lib` and `check-types-test` 0 errors before and after,
eslint and prettier clean.
- I didn't run the VR suite (Docker).

## Screenshots (if appropriate):

Before, 3.10.1 from npm: the middle bubble is the same size as the z=-10
one and the tooltip stops at y.


![before](https://github.com/maxymlyskov/recharts/blob/c3c7e6c6b43c2191352c79468025a8e39de952d1/before.png?raw=true)

After, this branch built: the middle bubble sits between the other two
and the tooltip has `z : 0`.


![after](https://github.com/maxymlyskov/recharts/blob/c3c7e6c6b43c2191352c79468025a8e39de952d1/after.png?raw=true)
